```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
}))

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/03_biomarker_strategies.R"))
}))

# Create data_complete (same logic as 06_parametric_survival_analysis.R)
data_complete <- data[complete.cases(data[, c("Age", "sex", "Rx", "crp", "tlr",
                                               "tmb_braf", "OSwk", "Death",
                                               "PFSwk", "Progression")]), ]

cat("Complete cases:", nrow(data_complete), "\n")
```

```{r fit-all-models, include=FALSE}
# Helper to extract coefficients from a flexsurvreg object
extract_coefs <- function(model, model_label, outcome_label) {
  if (is.null(model) || !inherits(model, "flexsurvreg")) return(NULL)

  coef_table <- as.data.frame(model$res)
  coef_table$Parameter <- rownames(coef_table)
  coef_table$Model <- model_label
  coef_table$Outcome <- outcome_label
  rownames(coef_table) <- NULL

  coef_table <- coef_table %>%
    select(Model, Outcome, Parameter, est, se, L95 = `L95%`, U95 = `U95%`)

  return(coef_table)
}

# Fit gamma models for each specification
model_specs <- list(
  A = list(
    structure = 0,
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp:Rx + tlr:Rx + tmb_braf:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp:Rx + tlr:Rx + tmb_braf:Rx
  ),
  B_crp = list(
    structure = 1,
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tmb_braf + crp:Rx + tmb_braf:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tmb_braf + crp:Rx + tmb_braf:Rx
  ),
  B_tlr = list(
    structure = 1,
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tmb_braf + tlr:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tmb_braf + tlr:Rx
  ),
  C_crp = list(
    structure = 2,
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp:Rx
  ),
  C_tlr = list(
    structure = 2,
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + tlr:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + tlr:Rx
  ),
  C_tmb = list(
    structure = 2,
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + tmb_braf:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + tmb_braf:Rx
  )
)

# Model labels for display
model_display_labels <- c(
  A = "Model A (Joint)",
  B_crp = "Model B: CRP/TMB-BRAF formula",
  B_tlr = "Model B: TLR formula",
  C_crp = "Model C: CRP only",
  C_tlr = "Model C: TLR only",
  C_tmb = "Model C: TMB/BRAF only"
)

all_coefs <- data.frame()

for (spec_name in names(model_specs)) {
  spec <- model_specs[[spec_name]]
  display_label <- model_display_labels[spec_name]

  for (outcome in c("os", "pfs")) {
    formula <- spec[[outcome]]
    outcome_label <- toupper(outcome)

    fit <- tryCatch(
      flexsurvreg(formula = formula, data = data_complete, dist = "gamma"),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("Failed to fit", spec_name, outcome, ":", e$message, "\n")
        NULL
      }
    )

    coefs <- extract_coefs(fit, display_label, outcome_label)
    if (!is.null(coefs)) {
      all_coefs <- rbind(all_coefs, coefs)
    }
  }
}

cat("Total coefficient rows:", nrow(all_coefs), "\n")
```

```{r display-tables}
# Display one table per model specification
for (spec_label in unique(all_coefs$Model)) {
  spec_data <- all_coefs %>%
    filter(Model == spec_label)

  display_df <- spec_data %>%
    mutate(
      Coefficient = sprintf("%.4f", est),
      SE = sprintf("%.4f", se),
      `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.4f, %.4f]", L95, U95)
    ) %>%
    select(Outcome, Parameter, Coefficient, SE, `95% CI`)

  cat("\n\n")
  print(kable(display_df,
              caption = paste("Table S4:", spec_label, "- Gamma model coefficients"),
              format = "html",
              row.names = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE,
                  font_size = 11) %>%
    pack_rows(index = table(display_df$Outcome)))
}
```

```{r footnotes}
cat("\n\n**Notes:**\n\n")
cat("- All models use gamma distribution for both OS and PFS.\n")
cat("- Model A (Joint): All three biomarker-treatment interactions in a single model.\n")
cat("- Model B (Focused): CRP and TMB/BRAF as covariates with both interaction terms; TLR uses separate formula with only TLR:Rx interaction.\n")
cat("- Model C (Separate): One biomarker and its treatment interaction per model.\n")
cat("- All models adjusted for age and sex.\n")
cat("- Rx = treatment arm (experimental vs control). Interaction terms (e.g., crp1:Rx) represent treatment-biomarker interaction effects.\n")
```

if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {

}

write.csv(all_coefs, file = here("tables", "table_s4.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
